---
title: "Plots and data API"
toc-depth: 3
---

A plot starts with `Plot::of()` or `ggplot()`, which take the data and optional mappings. The data can be rows, columns, a phibble table, a Laravel collection, or a `Data` source. [Data and fields](data.qmd) explains the forms data can take, and [Large data](large-data.qmd) explains when to bin in PHP with `Bin`.
